scientific_role: bounded interface sensitivity after completion of the matched-historical primary comparator

primary_result_immutability.interpretive_boundary: This sensitivity cannot replace, tune, suppress, or retrospectively redefine the completed matched-historical result.

sensitivity_configuration.model_identity_rule: Use the exact Q2_K artifact, quantization, model SHA-256, context size, grammar, and deterministic sampling receipt from the completed primary configuration.
sensitivity_configuration.only_planned_change: Apply the model-native chat template and a frozen task message instead of raw-completion serialization.

allowed_use: validate template transport and structured-output compatibility
describe invalidity, degeneracy, truncation, latency, and label operating points
make one author-approved freeze decision before protected evaluation
prohibited_use: search multiple templates, prompts, quantizations, or seeds for the best score
use Zoe evaluation or Maria outcomes for selection
treat development performance as independent evidence

unlock_requirements: author approval of the scientific question
one frozen configuration selected without protected-evaluation access
new immutable run identifier and producing-bundle intake
evaluation_stage.analysis_rule: If unlocked, use the same exact-key paired analysis, report-level limitations, multiplicity family, and unfavorable-result policy as the completed primary comparator.
